claim_boundary: A found profile is an exact fixed-U-admissible witness that every complete four-support-edge EFX allocation splits the designated wild role, which is the one shape the realization-free reduction cannot close.  An unsat verdict proves no admissible profile with exactly one wild role and all others tame multi-good forces that role's split; it says nothing about profiles with several wild roles or with singleton roles present.
search_shape: one designated wild role, every other role tame multi-good; the allocation family forbids splitting the wild role and permits splitting any number of tame roles simultaneously
